trap.label: particípio irregular
trap.wrong: They might have took the wrong road.
trap.right: They might have taken the wrong road.
trap.why: O aluno mantém a forma do passado simples. Após have, use o particípio (taken).

mcq.why: might have + particípio = talvez tenha acontecido.

opts: We could have gone by train.
mcq.why: could have + particípio = poderíamos ter ido (mas não fomos).

fix.wrong: They could of won the game.
fix.right: They could have won the game.

fix.wrong: He may has lost his wallet.
fix.right: He may have lost his wallet.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com may: “She might have left.”
Reescreva com could have: “I can call her.” (oportunidade perdida)
Reescreva no passado: “She might be late.” (talvez tenha se atrasado)
